morphology.pattern_note: 不按马来语词缀拆分。常见英语读音有四个音节，重音落在含/maɪ/的音节；输入未提供音节字段，因此保留null。[Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/hermione)

senses.zh_definition: Hermione：源自希腊传统的女性人名；在《哈利·波特》语境中通常指赫敏·格兰杰。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name; in Harry Potter contexts, usually Hermione Granger.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang berasal daripada tradisi Yunani; dalam konteks Harry Potter, lazimnya merujuk kepada Hermione Granger.
senses.nuances: 实际书写应使用大写首字母Hermione。它是专名，不具有“聪明女孩”等普通名词义。未核实为DBP普通词条，马来语释义为编写的说明。以下为姓名及语境组合，并非经语料统计的高频搭配。[Oxford LGPN](https://lgpn.web.ox.ac.uk/greek-names-english), [Harry Potter官网](https://www.harrypotter.com/features/things-you-may-not-have-noticed-about-hermione)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam pembentangan tersebut, penceramah membincangkan watak Hermione Granger dalam siri Harry Potter.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该场报告中，主讲人讨论了《哈利·波特》系列中的赫敏·格兰杰这一角色。
dual_scenarios.en: In the presentation, the speaker discussed the character Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter series.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak baca bab pasal Hermione tu dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu membaca bab tentang Hermione itu terlebih dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想先看讲赫敏的那一章。
dual_scenarios.en: I want to read that chapter about Hermione first.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca bab pasal Hermione tu?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah membaca bab tentang Hermione itu?
messages.zh: 你看过讲赫敏的那一章了吗？
messages.en: Have you read that chapter about Hermione?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Aku nak baca malam ni.
messages.ms_standard: Belum lagi. Saya mahu membacanya malam ini.
messages.en: Not yet. I'm going to read it tonight.

etymology.historical_story: Hermione is an ancient Greek name, probably connected with Hermes. It appears in Greek mythology and later in Shakespeare's The Winter's Tale. Modern readers also encounter it through Hermione Granger. These literary associations explain its presence in discussions written in many languages, without making it a Malay common noun. [Oxford LGPN](https://lgpn.web.ox.ac.uk/greek-names-english), [Harry Potter官网](https://www.harrypotter.com/features/things-you-may-not-have-noticed-about-hermione)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语节奏记成her-MY-uh-nee，MY处重读；联想到赫敏即可，不把名字硬译成某种性格。
